Name: (AT) Spooky Big Shed
Author: MossiMods
Description:
[b][color=#00ff00]Installation instructions[/color][/b]
Unzip the file into your mods folder

In game, use the Paint Bucket Tool on your Big Shed's Exterior to choose one 
of these variants
[b][color=#b6d7a8]BONUS:[/color][/b] I also grabbed some sprites from other Stardew Valley Tilesheets 
and put them in a png so you can edit / add them onto your buildings if you want :D  

[color=#ffff00][size=4][font=Impact]Reminder: [/font][/size][/color] You need to build the Shed first, then go back to Robin, the Carpenter ,
and have the Big Shed built as an upgrade to your regular Shed 

If you want to get things built quickly , use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url]

First, Go to the Carpenter on a day and time she is open. The first Shed costs 15,000 Gold and requires 300 Wood.

Next, use the Item Spawner - Hit "I" on your keyboard and type the item you want into the search bar to instantly spawn it.
example: type in "paint bucket" to get the paint bucket, "wood" to find wood

Now hit "P" on your keyboard to enter the Cheats Menu. 
Go to the "Farm and Fishing" Tab and check the "Instant Build" Box to get buildings from Robin Built Instantly 
In the "Player and Tools" Tab, scroll down and you can add as much gold as you need to complete a build.

Once you have the Shed built where you'd like it, return to Robin with 20,000 Gold, 550 Wood, and 300 Stone.
You can instantly warp to Robin using the Cheats Menu Warp Locations Tab
Ask to build the Big Shed and choose your regular Shed to upgrade it! 

[b][color=#00ff00]Main features[/color][/b]
2 Spooky Variations of the Big Shed
to match my Spooky Farmhouse 3 mod.  
[b]BONUS: [/b]I also grabbed some sprites from other Stardew Valley Tilesheets 
and put them in a png so you can edit / add them onto your buildings if you want :D 

[b][color=#00ff00]Requirements[/color][/b]
Alternative Textures
SMAPI
